info.name: SignSync API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the SignSync backend — an ASL (American Sign Language) detection and learning platform.

## Setup
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your server (default: `http://localhost:8000`).
2. Call **Auth / Login** to get tokens. The collection auto-saves `accessToken` and `refreshToken` via a test script.
3. All protected requests use `{{accessToken}}` in the `Authorization` header automatically.

## Variables
| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:8000` | Server base URL |
| `accessToken` | _(set by Login)_ | JWT access token |
| `refreshToken` | _(set by Login)_ | JWT refresh token |
| `testUsername` | `john_doe` | Username for quick tests |
| `testPassword` | `SecurePass123!` | Password for quick tests |

variable.description: Base URL of the SignSync backend server
JWT access token — auto-populated by the Login request
JWT refresh token — auto-populated by the Login request
Default username used in test requests
Default password used in test requests

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: User registration, login, token refresh, and logout. Login auto-saves the access and refresh tokens to collection variables.

request.description:
Register a new user account.

**Auth required:** No

**Request fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | string | ✅ | Unique username |
| `email` | string | ✅ | Valid email address |
| `password` | string | ✅ | Min 8 characters |
| `first_name` | string | ❌ | Optional first name |
| `last_name` | string | ❌ | Optional last name |

**Response:** `201 Created` — full user profile object

**Errors:**
- `400` — email/username already in use
- `422` — validation error

exec: console.log('✅ Tokens saved to collection variables');

request.description:
Authenticate with username/email and password.

**Auth required:** No

**Content-Type:** `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (OAuth2 form data)

**Body fields:**
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `username` | Username **or** email address |
| `password` | User's password |

**Response:** `200 OK` — returns `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `token_type`, `user_role`

**Side-effects:** The test script in this request automatically saves `accessToken` and `refreshToken` to collection variables, so all other requests are ready to use right away.

**Response headers include:**
```
Set-Cookie: refresh_token=<token>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax
```

**Errors:**
- `401` — wrong credentials
- `422` — missing form fields

header.description: The refresh token cookie set during login. In browsers this is sent automatically; set manually here for Postman.

request.description:
Exchange the refresh token for a new short-lived access token.

**Auth required:** Cookie `refresh_token` (set by Login)

**No request body needed.** The refresh token is read from the `refresh_token` HttpOnly cookie.

In Postman, the Cookie header is set manually to `{{refreshToken}}`.

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ access_token, token_type }`

**Errors:**
- `401` — refresh token missing, expired, or already blacklisted

header.description: Refresh token cookie — required to blacklist both tokens

request.description:
Invalidate the current session. Blacklists both the access token and the refresh token. After this call, further requests with either token will be rejected.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token + Cookie `refresh_token`)

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ message: 'Logged out successfully' }`

**Errors:**
- `401` — refresh token not found or invalid

item.name: ❤️ Health
item.description: Liveness and readiness probes. No authentication needed.

request.description:
Simple liveness probe. Confirms the process is running. Returns app name, version, and environment.

**Auth required:** No

**Response:** `200 OK`
```json
{ "app": "SignSync", "environment": "local", "version": "0.1.0" }
```

Readiness probe. Tests connectivity to PostgreSQL and Redis before confirming the app can serve traffic. Use in Kubernetes readiness probes or deployment health gates.

**Auth required:** No

**Response `200 OK`** (all healthy):
```json
{ "status": "ready", "services": { "database": "healthy", "redis": "healthy" } }
```

**Response `503`** (a dependency is down):
```json
{ "status": "not ready", "services": { "database": "healthy", "redis": "unhealthy" } }
```

item.name: 👤 User Profile
item.description: Manage the authenticated user's own profile, preferences, and profile image.

request.description:
Retrieve the currently authenticated user's full profile — personal details, preferences (language, country), and profile image URL.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Response:** `200 OK` — full user profile object

Partial update on the current user's profile. Only the fields you include are changed.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**All body fields are optional:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | New email address |
| `username` | string | New unique username |
| `first_name` | string | First name |
| `last_name` | string | Last name |
| `bio` | string | Short biography |
| `country` | string | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code |
| `language` | string | Language code (e.g. `en`) |

**Errors:**
- `409` — email or username already taken
- `422` — validation error

formdata.description: Image file to upload. Supported: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP. Max 5 MB.

request.description:
Upload a profile picture. Stored in `media/profile_images/` on the server.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`

**Form field:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | file | Image file (JPEG / PNG / GIF / WebP, max 5 MB) |

**Response:** `200 OK` — updated user object with new `profile_image_url`

**Errors:**
- `400` — unsupported file type or missing filename
- `413` — file exceeds 5 MB

Remove the current user's profile picture. Deletes the file from storage and sets `profile_image_url` to `null`.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ message: 'Profile image deleted successfully' }`

Soft-delete the authenticated user's own account. The account is marked inactive but data is retained. The user cannot log in afterwards.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ message: 'User deleted successfully' }`

item.name: 🤟 Signs (Reference Images)
item.description: Retrieve the active ASL reference sign images displayed to users. One endpoint per character.

request.description:
Get the active reference image URL for a given ASL character. Images are served from Cloudinary CDN.

**Auth required:** No

**Path parameter:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `character` | string | Single letter A–Z or the word `space` |

**Examples:**
- `GET /api/v1/signs/A`
- `GET /api/v1/signs/Z`
- `GET /api/v1/signs/space`

**Response:** `200 OK` — sign object with `character`, `cloudinary_url`, `is_active`, `created_at`

**Errors:**
- `404` — character not found or no active image assigned

item.name: 🤖 Prediction
item.description: Submit hand images to the ML model for ASL sign prediction. Supports single-frame HTTP and real-time WebSocket streaming.

formdata.description: Hand skeleton image — white landmarks on black background. JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP, max 5 MB.

request.description:
Submit a single hand-skeleton image to the ML model and get the predicted ASL sign with a confidence score.

The model uses **MediaPipe** to extract skeletal landmarks and a trained **MobileNet CNN** to classify the gesture.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`

**Form field:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | file | Hand skeleton image (white landmarks on black background). Max 5 MB. |

**Response:** `200 OK`
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Detected gesture: A (95%)",
  "data": { "label": "A", "confidence": 95.0 },
  "query_generated_time": 0.1234
}
```

**Possible label values:**
| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `A`–`Z` | Detected ASL letter |
| `space` | Space gesture |
| `del` | Delete/backspace gesture |
| `nothing` | No gesture detected |
| `no_hand` | No hand skeleton in image |
| `uncertain` | Confidence below threshold |
| `error` | Model processing failed |

**Errors:**
- `400` — unsupported file type or >5 MB
- `503` — ML model not loaded

query.description: JWT access token — WebSocket auth is done via this query param since HTTP headers aren't supported during WS handshake

request.description:
Real-time sign prediction via WebSocket. Connect once and stream raw image frames as binary messages.

> **Note:** To test WebSockets, use Postman's **WebSocket** request type or a tool like `wscat`. This entry is a reference card.

**Auth required:** `?token=<access_token>` query parameter

**Connection URL:**
```
ws://localhost:8000/api/v1/predict/ws?token=<your_access_token>
```

**Client → Server:** Send raw binary image data (JPEG/PNG bytes) as a binary WebSocket frame.

**Server → Client** (JSON text frame per image):
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "label": "A", "confidence": 92.5 }, "time": "0.12s", "frame": 1 }
```

**WebSocket close codes:**
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| `4001` | Invalid/missing token or user not found |
| `1000` | Normal closure |

Get metadata about the prediction service — supported gestures, model type, and availability status. Use this to dynamically populate gesture lists in the UI.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Response:** `200 OK`
```json
{
  "status": "available",
  "model_type": "cnn_mediapipe",
  "supported_gestures": ["A","B",...,"Z","space","del","nothing"],
  "total_classes": 29
}
```

Check whether the ML model is loaded and ready to serve predictions.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Response `200 OK`** (model ready):
```json
{ "status": "healthy", "model_loaded": true, "model_type": "cnn_mediapipe" }
```

**Response `503`** (model not loaded):
```json
{ "status": "unhealthy", "model_loaded": false, "model_type": null }
```

item.name: 📊 Sign Detections
item.description: Log and manage individual sign detection records. Every prediction result can be saved here for analytics and learning history.

request.description:
Log a single sign detection result to the database. Call this after every successful prediction to persist it for analytics.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Request fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `detected_sign` | string | ✅ | Predicted sign label (A–Z, space, del, etc.) |
| `confidence` | float | ✅ | Model confidence, 0.0–1.0 |
| `is_correct` | boolean | ❌ | Whether user confirmed the prediction |
| `session_id` | string | ❌ | Groups detections from the same practice session |
| `duration_seconds` | float | ❌ | Time taken for the detection |

**Response:** `201 Created` — the saved detection record

**Errors:**
- `422` — confidence out of range or invalid fields
- `429` — rate limit exceeded

Log multiple detection results in a single request. More efficient than logging one at a time — ideal for flushing a full practice session.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Accepts:** 1 to 100 detections per request in the `detections` array.

**Response:** `201 Created`
```json
{ "message": "3 detections logged", "count": 3 }
```

**Errors:**
- `422` — empty list or more than 100 items

Retrieve a paginated list of all sign detections logged by the current user, ordered by most recent first.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Query parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | int | `1` | Page number |
| `items_per_page` | int | `20` | Items per page (max 100) |

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ data: [...], total_count, page, items_per_page }`

Retrieve a single detection record by its ID. Only the owner of the detection can access it.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `id` (int) — detection record ID

**Errors:**
- `404` — not found or belongs to another user

Update a detection record — typically to mark whether the prediction was correct or adjust the confidence value. Only the owner can update their own detections.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `id` (int) — detection record ID

**All body fields are optional:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `is_correct` | boolean | Whether the prediction was correct |
| `confidence` | float | Updated confidence value (0.0–1.0) |

Soft-delete a detection record. The record is marked as deleted but remains in the database for audit purposes. It won't appear in list results or analytics.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `id` (int) — detection record ID

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ message: 'Detection deleted successfully' }`

item.name: 📈 Dashboard
item.description: Comprehensive learning analytics for the authenticated user.

query.description: Number of past days to include in trend data. Range: 1–90. Default: 7.

request.description:
Retrieve a comprehensive analytics summary for the current user's sign language practice.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Query parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `days` | int | `7` | Past days window for trend data (1–90) |

**Response includes:**
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `stats.total_signs_detected` | All-time detection count |
| `stats.today_signs_count` | Detections logged today |
| `stats.total_practice_hours` | Total practice duration in hours |
| `stats.average_accuracy` | Overall correct-prediction ratio (0–1) |
| `stats.accuracy_change` | Accuracy change vs previous period |
| `stats.current_streak` | Consecutive days with ≥1 detection |
| `frequent_signs` | Top detected signs by count |
| `daily_activity` | Per-day detection counts for the period |
| `accuracy_distribution` | Breakdown: high/medium/low confidence |
| `mastered_letters` | Count of letters with consistently high accuracy |
| `recommended_letters` | Letters the user should practice more |

item.name: ⚙️ Background Tasks
item.description: Enqueue and poll asynchronous background jobs via ARQ/Redis.

query.description: Payload message for the background task (required)

request.description:
Enqueue an asynchronous background job on the ARQ/Redis worker queue. Rate-limited per user.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Query parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | string | ✅ | Payload message for the background task |

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ id: 'task_7f3e9a12b4c5' }`

**Errors:**
- `429` — rate limit exceeded

Poll the status and result of a previously enqueued background task.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `task_id` (string) — returned by the Enqueue Task endpoint

**Response:** `200 OK`
```json
{ "id": "task_7f3e9a12b4c5", "status": "complete", "result": "Task completed successfully" }
```

**Status values:** `in_progress`, `complete`, `failed`

item.name: 🏷️ Tiers
item.description: Subscription tier management. Tiers define rate limits per user group. Write operations are admin-only.

request.description:
Create a new subscription tier. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Request fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | ✅ | Unique tier name (e.g. `free`, `pro`) |
| `description` | string | ❌ | Human-readable description |

**Response:** `201 Created` — new tier object

List all available subscription tiers with pagination.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Query parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | int | `1` | Page number |
| `items_per_page` | int | `10` | Items per page |

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ data: [...], total_count, page, items_per_page }`

Get a single tier by its name.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `name` (string) — tier name (e.g. `free`, `pro`)

**Response:** `200 OK` — tier object

Update an existing tier's details. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `name` (string) — tier name to update

**Response:** `200 OK` — updated tier object

Delete a tier by name. **Admin (superuser) only.** Will fail if users are still assigned to this tier.

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `name` (string) — tier name

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ message: 'Tier deleted successfully' }`

item.name: ⏱️ Rate Limits
item.description: Configure per-tier API rate limit rules. Admin-only write operations.

request.description:
Create a rate limit rule for a specific tier and API path. **Admin (superuser) only.**

Example: limit the `free` tier to 10 prediction requests per minute.

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `tier_name` (string) — the tier to apply this rule to

**Request fields:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | API path this rule applies to (e.g. `/api/v1/predict/`) |
| `limit` | int | Max requests allowed in the time window |
| `period` | int | Time window in seconds |

**Response:** `201 Created` — new rate limit rule object

List all rate limit rules configured for a specific tier.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `tier_name` (string) — tier name

**Response:** `200 OK` — paginated list of rate limit rules

Get a specific rate limit rule by ID.

**Auth required:** Yes (Bearer token)

**Path parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tier_name` | string | Tier name |
| `id` | int | Rate limit rule ID |

**Response:** `200 OK` — single rate limit rule object

Update an existing rate limit rule. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameters:** `tier_name` (string), `id` (int)

**Body fields (all optional):** `limit` (int), `period` (int)

**Response:** `200 OK` — updated rule object

Delete a rate limit rule. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameters:** `tier_name` (string), `id` (int)

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ message: 'Rate limit deleted successfully' }`

item.name: 🛡️ Admin — Users
item.description: Full user lifecycle management. All routes in this folder require superuser privileges.

request.description:
Create a user account directly (admin bypass — no email verification). Used to programmatically create test accounts or onboard users.

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Request fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | string | ✅ | Unique username |
| `email` | string | ✅ | Valid email |
| `password` | string | ✅ | Min 8 characters |
| `first_name` | string | ❌ | First name |
| `last_name` | string | ❌ | Last name |
| `is_superuser` | boolean | ❌ | Grant admin rights (default: false) |

**Response:** `201 Created` — full user profile object

List all registered users with pagination. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Query parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | int | `1` | Page number |
| `items_per_page` | int | `20` | Items per page |

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ data: [...], total_count, page, items_per_page }`

Get the full profile of any user by username. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `username` (string)

**Response:** `200 OK` — full user profile including tier assignment

Update any field on any user's profile, including `is_active` and `is_superuser` flags. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `username` (string)

**All body fields are optional.** Supports same fields as user self-update plus `is_active` and `is_superuser`.

**Response:** `200 OK` — updated user profile

Soft-delete a user account. Marks the user as inactive but retains all their data. The user cannot log in after this action.

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `username` (string)

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ message: 'User deleted successfully' }`

⚠️ **IRREVERSIBLE** — Hard-delete a user and ALL their associated data permanently from the database.

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `username` (string)

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ message: 'User permanently deleted' }`

Get the subscription tier currently assigned to a user. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `username` (string)

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ user_id, username, tier_name }`

Assign or update a user's subscription tier. Changes which rate limits apply to the user. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `username` (string)

**Body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tier_name` | string | ✅ | Name of the tier to assign |

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ user_id, username, tier_name }`

View all effective rate limits that apply to a specific user based on their current tier. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `username` (string)

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ username, tier_name, rate_limits: [{ path, limit, period }] }`

item.name: 🖼️ Admin — Signs
item.description: Manage the ASL reference sign image library. Each character (A–Z + space) can have multiple Cloudinary versions with one marked as active.

request.description:
List all sign image records along with which ASL characters are still missing an active image. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ signs: [...], missing_characters: ['J', 'Z'] }`

Get sign image completion statistics — how many of the 27 characters (A–Z + space) have an active image assigned. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Response:** `200 OK`
```json
{ "total_characters": 27, "characters_with_images": 25, "completion_percent": 92.6, "missing": ["J", "Z"] }
```

List all Cloudinary image versions ever uploaded for a specific character. Used in the admin UI to select which version to set as active. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `character` (string) — A–Z or `space`

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ character, images: [{ id, cloudinary_url, is_active, version, file_size, ... }] }`

formdata.description: Image file to upload and set as the new active sign image for this character

request.description:
Upload a new reference sign image for a character. The image is sent to Cloudinary and automatically set as the new active image. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `character` (string) — A–Z or `space`

**Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`

**Form field:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | file | Image file to upload |

**Response:** `200 OK` — full Cloudinary image record with `cloudinary_url`, `file_size`, `width`, `height`, `version`, etc.

**Errors:**
- `400` — invalid character value
- `502` — Cloudinary upload failed

formdata.description: Multiple image files. The character is determined from the filename: A.jpg → A, space.jpg → space.

request.description:
Upload multiple sign images at once. The ASL character is inferred from the filename (e.g. `A.jpg` → character `A`, `space.jpg` → `space`). **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`

**Form field:** `files` (multiple file inputs)

**Response:** `200 OK`
```json
{ "uploaded": ["A", "B", "C"], "failed": [], "count": 3 }
```

Switch the active image for a character to a different previously-uploaded Cloudinary version. Use this to roll back to an older image without re-uploading. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Path parameter:** `character` (string) — A–Z or `space`

**Body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cloudinary_public_id` | string | ✅ | The Cloudinary public ID of the version to activate |

**Response:** `200 OK` — `{ character, active_image_id, cloudinary_url }`

item.name: 🖥️ Admin — Dashboard
item.description: System-wide analytics and reporting for admins.

request.description:
System-wide analytics — total users, daily active users, total detections, growth percentages, recent activity, top users, and health status of all services (DB, Redis, ML model, WebSocket, Cloudinary). **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Response includes:**
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `stats.total_users` | Total registered users |
| `stats.active_users_today` | Users with at least one detection today |
| `stats.total_detections` | All-time platform detections |
| `stats.system_health` | Overall system health percentage |
| `stats.user_growth_percent` | User growth vs previous period |
| `recent_activities` | Latest detection events across all users |
| `system_services` | Status of each infrastructure component |
| `top_users` | Most active users by detection count |

Export a full user activity report as a CSV file. Includes username, email, detection counts, accuracy stats, last activity, tier, and join date. **Admin (superuser) only.**

**Auth required:** Yes (superuser Bearer token)

**Response:** `200 OK`
- Content-Type: `text/csv`
- Content-Disposition: `attachment; filename="signsync_report.csv"`

**CSV columns:** `username, email, total_detections, average_accuracy, last_activity, tier, joined_at`
